name: Audible

fastest.text: On audible.com, select your name → Membership details → Cancel membership, then Confirm cancellation.

steps: Sign in at audible.com in a web browser and select your name in the top navigation.
Select Confirm cancellation. Audible emails you a confirmation.
note: Billed through Google Play? Cancel it in the Play Store; the Audible site can't cancel it.

faq.a: Use them first. At the end of your final billing cycle, Audible Premium members lose unused credits and member benefits.
Yes. Titles you bought with credits or a card stay in your library.
If you have credits you don't want to lose, you may be eligible to pause your membership instead of cancelling.

faq.q: Does deleting the app cancel my membership?
faq.a: No. Deleting the Audible app doesn't cancel anything; you have to cancel on the Audible website.
